_comment: Bedrock inference target for the Gateway, via the built-in `bedrock-runtime` CONNECTOR. This is the deprecation-safe path: bedrock-runtime is the native Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel endpoint (the older `bedrock-mantle` endpoint is being deprecated, so we do NOT use it). The connector auto-handles model discovery, model-id translation, and path rewriting, so no manual operations/modelMapping are needed. Default live path for the module's migration (GPT-5.6 Luna -> GPT-6 Luna, both OpenAI-on-Bedrock). Outbound auth is the gateway IAM role. setup_gateway.py fills gatewayIdentifier at create time.
name: bedrock
